training.initialization: Copy identical frozen v3 parameter arrays into fresh BalancedPolicy; zero Adam moments and update count; explicitly reset RNG after construction.
training.endpoint: Fixed episode 1024; no internal validation, best checkpoint selection, or early stopping.
training.advantage_normalization: Unchanged BalancedPolicy.update: raw return-to-go minus recorded value; for more than one transition and standard deviation above 1e-8, subtract batch mean and divide by standard deviation plus 1e-8; otherwise use raw advantages.
training.experience_pairing: Identical scenario seeds and first-batch actor RNG. Later action trajectories and RNG draw counts can diverge after updates.

validation.confidence_interval: Two-sided percentile 95%; 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles. Resample paired case indices independently within each profile and average three profile means with equal weights.
validation.checkpoint_selection: Only fixed last endpoints; initialized weights are identical to frozen balanced_v3.

scale_gate.interpretation: All conditions must hold against both comparators. This is a development screen for multi-seed replication, not promotion or statistical noninferiority. The no_critic_gradient arm is diagnostic only; compare paired_stop directly with it before attributing gains to the baseline. Cost or return improvements alone never pass.

diagnostics: First-batch sampled trajectory equality across arms before updates.
Raw and normalized advantage, return-to-go, and baseline moments by first/later decision and STOP/deploy.
Actor-plus-entropy and weighted critic gradient norms, combined clipping, and numerical diagnostic timing.
Live episode and counterfactual branch counts, elapsed simulation/training time, sensing, cost, and scenario profile summaries.
Paired validation sensing, success, return, and cost differences including paired_stop versus no_critic_gradient.
limitations: One training seed and 1024 live episodes per arm: scenario confidence intervals do not measure training-seed uncertainty.
The initial STOP return is constant -10.5; any later-state credit-assignment benefit does not remove first-placement scenario variance.

Raw STOP advantage zero can become nonzero after existing batch centering. Existing transition-count averaging and advantage normalization are retained, not claimed to be an unbiased estimator or a pure variance-only intervention.
With zero critic coefficient and fresh Adam, critic head arrays stay fixed but baseline predictions can drift as the shared actor encoder changes.
Paired STOP uses additional training-only simulated branch rollouts. It does not expose private reward, future truth, or branch state to actor observations.
Synthetic initial sequential sensor type/site planning only; timely confirmed sensing is not interception. Physics, reward, public observation, architecture, and inference contracts are unchanged.
A failed pilot is not proof that the method cannot work; a passing pilot requires multi-seed replication on separate development scenarios before any reserved final evaluation.
